context: Evaluates whether the agent builds a pedantry/semantic-argument-driven sketch that escalates through consistent logic and ends abruptly without breaking deadpan or reusing real Python material.

checklist.name: pedantry_engine_present
checklist.description: The sketch is driven primarily by a definitional/semantic dispute over what counts as a chair, not by an unrelated plot device.

checklist.name: consistent_escalation
checklist.description: At least two escalating beats appear, each a logical consequence of the previous beat, rather than a repeated restatement or an unrelated random event.

checklist.name: deadpan_maintained
checklist.description: No character breaks character, winks at the audience, or otherwise comments that the scene is absurd or a joke.

checklist.name: no_reproduction
checklist.description: No dialogue, character name, or scene structure is reused from an actual existing Monty Python sketch.

checklist.name: abrupt_ending
checklist.description: The sketch ends with a dry anticlimax, sudden cut, or reversal rather than a tidy resolution, apology, or stated moral.
